dioscorides.excerpt: σιδηρῖτις, οἱ δὲ Ἡρακλείαν· πόα ἐστὶ φύλλα ἔχουσα ὅμοια πρασίῳ, ἐπιμηκέστερα δὲ πρὸς τὰ τοῦ ἐλελισφάκου ἢ δρυός
dioscorides.edition: Wellmann 1906, Pedanii Dioscuridis Anazarbei De materia medica vol. II (libri III-IV), Berlin: Weidmann; read from page scan on archive.org (BIUSante_65865x02), pp. 193-194

identification.source: Sprengel 1830, vol. 2, pp. 588-589 (Comm. IV cap. XXXIII, Sideritis prima): Matthiolus 'hallucinatus est' proposing Lycopus europaeus; 'Magis placet Fuchsii sententia, qui Stachyos rectae effigiem huc collocat'; Fab. Columna proposed Stachys heraclea All., Clusius Sideritis scordioides. Sprengel does NOT name Sideritis syriaca or any Sideritis as Dioscorides' plant. | Fraas 1845, p. 175: Sideritis syriaca L. is assigned NOT to σιδηρῖτις but to κέστρον Diosc. 4,1 (betony; Sibthorp put Betonica alopecurus there); Fraas notes Aegineta distinguishes the 'Greek betony' (Sid. syriaca) from κέστρον. Fraas assigns Sideritis romana / S. elegans tentatively to φλομίδες ('?'). Osbaldeston 2000, ch. 4-33 SIDERITIS: SUGGESTED Sideritis prima [Fuchs], Sideritis vulgaris hirsuta erecta [Bauhin], Betonica annua var hirsuta, Stachys recta [Linnaeus], Stachys procumbens, Stachys sideritis. (https://archive.org/details/BIUSante_dioscsprengelx02/page/n590/mode/1up ; https://archive.org/details/synopsisplantaru00fraa/page/n220/mode/1up)
